title: A connected company's key is USE ONLY, and connecting is a human act no tool can do
summary: Companies one owner runs can be connected so each can use the others' gateway keys. An agent sees this through two reads only: `gate_subscriptions` lists the other companies' keys under a top-level `connected` array (owner, provider, label, health, plan, price per month, account email, use_only: true), and `gate_group` says whether the company is connected and who sends requests through its own keys. Three traps. First, a connected key looks like any other key, but every write on it (update/delete/test_brand_integration) answers 404 because the brand-integration routes are scoped to the keys a brand owns. Second, there is deliberately no tool to connect, disconnect or pair: the dashboard routes for it are session-only and answer an API client 403 human_act_required, identically on every retry, and the build fails if a tool with such a name is added. Third, `group: null` (or no `connected` key on /subscriptions) is the answer 'not connected', not a failed call. Keep private can be turned ON by an agent (`update_brand_integration` keep_private: true) and only OFF by a human.
